First look of Devi Sri Prasad from ‘Yellamma’ | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement
Film production banner Sri Venkateswara Creations on Wednesday (October 21) unveiled the first look at acclaimed music composer Devi Sri Prasad 's debut acting venture, Yellamma . The film, written and directed by Venu Yeldandi, is set to release in theatres on March 5, 2027.
The first look features DSP in a distinct look as Parshi, the film’s lead character. A previously released glimpse video of the film promises a raw and rustic tale. Details regarding the plot and rest of the cast are unknown at the moment.
A powerful story emerging from the roots of our land, ready to find its voice across the nation! 🔥 #Yellamma ~ Grand Worldwide Theatrical Release on MARCH 5th, 2027! ❤️‍🔥 In Telugu, Tamil, Hindi, Kannada & Malayalam.💥 #YellammaFromMarch5th Rockstar 🌟 @ThisIsDSP @VenuYeldandi9 #DilRaju #Shirish @HR_3555 @muraligdop @Hr_3555 #HanshithaReddy @svc_official @Tseries @tseriessouth
Currently in production, Yellamma has music scored by DSP himself and cinematography by Murali G.
Dil Raju presents the film, and Shirish produces it under the Sri Venkateswara Creations banner. The film will be released in Telugu, Tamil, Hindi, Malayalam and Kannada.
